sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: special driving conditions (night, weather, emergencies, floods, work zones and stopped emergency vehicles)
Knowledge facts: part C holds 38 fact blocks (sec08-F01 onward) from physical pages 56 to 61; part C2 holds 20 confusable and continuation blocks (sec08-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-SPEC-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-SPEC-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-SPEC-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-SPEC-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-SPEC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-SPEC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the studded-tire season, work-zone penalties, the emergency shoulder-use list and the night-crash statistic are set by statute or data year (for example sec08-F14, sec08-F33) and should be refreshed from the current Nevada handbook.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
